role: independent static load research case; does not replace synthetic baseline or select a procurable LED
evidence_level: published measured I-V source-data curve, normalized and replayed independently

source.paper_title: Transfer-printed yellow and red InGaN micro-LEDs on diamond for ultra-low-power high-speed optical interconnects
source.curve_locator: I-V.xlsx Sheet1 A1:B102; header 20μm yellow; Fig.2a yellow 20μm curve

device.color_label: yellow (source label; wavelength depends on current)
device.current_density_area_basis: square mesa area, as used by source current/current-density conversion; not a measured local current distribution

measurement.instrument: Keithley 2614B precision source meter (paper Methods: Measurement method)
measurement.temperature_status: not reported for this I-V sweep; room temperature is not assumed

simulation_interface.type: behavioral current source with piecewise-linear measured I(V)
simulation_interface.outside_domain: a numerical linear extension to (0 V, 0 A) below first point, then standard PWL extrapolation; no measured reverse/off/high-current validation

same_curve_holdout.method: linear V versus I; inversely equivalent to linear I versus V;  every fourth knot index modulo 4 equals 1 withheld; endpoints retained
same_curve_holdout.interpretation: same-curve interpolation error;  not cross-device or cross-temperature generalization

permitted_research_use: static full-on current/headroom under the source curve
sensitivity comparison against synthetic baseline with clear evidence labels
not_supported: PWM rise/fall timing or bandwidth without separately declared assumed capacitance
manufacturing/purchasability or same-device integration with the GF180 layout
